entities.summary: Carl Günther Ludovici was a philosopher, lexicographer and economist from Leipzig in the Electorate of Saxony in the Holy Roman Empire. He edited a large part of the Grosses vollständiges Universal-Lexicon, a major German encyclopedia of the 18th century.
